title: A Great Day for the Irish

evidence.paraphrase: Space travel is established, and quarantine of incoming ships occurs at the Moon.
evidence.quote: Ever since the beginnings of space travel, the quarantine of incoming ships at the Moon had been rigidly observed.

evidence.paraphrase: The protagonist departs Earth to travel across space to another planet.
evidence.quote: she was about to board one of the shining ships herself

evidence.paraphrase: New Eden is described as a frontier planet being settled.
evidence.quote: She was bound for the frontier, where men are men and women are scarce.

evidence.paraphrase: New Eden is a planet with no stinging insects or parasites.
evidence.quote: Eden's remarkable that way," put in the young officer sitting across from them. "No stinging bugs or parasites.

evidence.paraphrase: A drug called covitron is used to counter space sickness.
evidence.quote: take the prescribed dose of covitron against space sickness

evidence.paraphrase: Imported seeds from another star system were destroyed because they carried a blight dangerous to Earth.
evidence.quote: the seeds had been found to harbor a blight which, once let loose on Earth

evidence.paraphrase: Bridget explains that shamrocks carry the golden nematode pest in their root soil.
evidence.quote: I remember that shamrocks harbor the golden nematode--that is, in the soil around the roots.

evidence.paraphrase: Bridget uses a microscope to examine plant specimens for pests.
evidence.quote: Bridget brought out her pocket 'scope and without a word pulled the first specimen up by the roots and began to examine it.

evidence.paraphrase: Bridget identifies a nematode cyst and explains its danger as a spreading pest.
evidence.quote: it's a nematode cyst, all right. That little brown lump, if turned loose in the soil--give it a few years and you'll have a real pest on your hands.

evidence.paraphrase: Bridget cites a historical case where the nematode destroyed potato farming.
evidence.quote: The golden nematode ruined Long Island for potatoes. That's what the shamrock did for America!

evidence.paraphrase: A plague is reported on New Eden, causing passengers to avoid landing.
evidence.quote: There's a howling plague on New Eden after all. Several of our passengers have changed their minds about landing.

evidence.paraphrase: A mysterious agent is turning New Eden to desert, threatening starvation and evacuation.
evidence.quote: The beautiful garden planet of New Eden was being reduced to a desert by a mysterious _something_ that was swiftly attacking all the cultivated areas. Starvation was looming and there was talk of hasty evacuation.

evidence.paraphrase: Scientists systematically investigate possible causes by testing insects and soils.
evidence.quote: Was it an insect, a virus, a chemical in the soil? Some of the few native insects were caught and subjected to experiment. The soils were analyzed and tested.

evidence.paraphrase: The observable effect of the plague is soil turning to chalky sand and plants dying.
evidence.quote: the previously lush brown loam was turning to a yellow, chalky sand, and everything that grew in it withered and died

evidence.paraphrase: Bridget tests soil samples and correlates nematode presence with absence of the plague.
evidence.quote: Patch ran back and forth with the soil samples and Bridget looked in her microscope, and everywhere the golden nematode was teeming and nowhere was there a sign of the sinister yellow streaks.

evidence.paraphrase: Bridget concludes that the nematodes are destroying the plague agent.
evidence.quote: Whatever it is, the nematodes are killing it.

evidence.paraphrase: They plan to breed the nematodes as a biological remedy for the plague.
evidence.quote: while they're proving it, Patch, you and I are going to breed nematodes right here

evidence.paraphrase: Reflection that overly strict quarantine can exclude beneficial organisms.
evidence.quote: Sometimes the watchdogs are too faithful. They keep out everyone--even our friends.

evidence.paraphrase: Maguire reacts with outrage when his shamrocks are to be destroyed.
evidence.quote: "The incinerator!" screamed Maguire. "Woman! My shamrocks! All the way from Ireland!"

evidence.paraphrase: An Earth pest was overlooked and introduced to New Eden amid the planet's own plague.
evidence.quote: they were so busy worrying about the plague here, they forgot all about the little plague from Earth
